sources.note: Rakes, harvest methods, drying and roe collection; later metal tines are distinguished from older materials.

sources.title: Tla’amin Nation, Our Culture
sources.note: Family responsibilities, Elders, ceremonies and ancestral names, in the Nation’s own contemporary account.

sources.title: Tla’amin Nation, Service Model
sources.note: Baby-basket metaphor, service design and the continuing effects of colonial dispossession and child removal.

sources.title: Tla’amin Nation, Culture and Language Department
sources.note: Programming, recordings, off-Lands access, heritage work and adoption of the revitalisation strategy on September 3, 2025.

sources.title: Tla’amin Nation, Treaty
sources.note: Negotiations from 1994, signing in 2014 and effect on April 5, 2016. Confused introductory wording about Confederation is excluded.
